title: Microsoft 365 Exchange Online Tenant-to-Tenant Migration (1:1 Domains)
author_notes: Drive a Microsoft 365 Exchange migration 1 to 1 domains.

Scope: Exchange Online mailbox tenant-to-tenant migration (source M365 tenant -> target M365 tenant) with a 1:1 primary-domain cutover and mail-flow coexistence, using Quest On Demand Migration (native MRS / ShareGate / BitTitan as alternatives). Email-focused; SharePoint/Teams/Azure covered by the separate GCC High program product.
pricing: T4 (project/migration) — multi-phase migration with coexistence + cutover + 3rd-party tooling; anchor $3,495, above the prior product per the monotonicity rule.
